peak_basis: One Blackhole ASIC:120 physical Tensix cores x4096 FLOPs/cycle x1.35GHz LoFi nominal peak;512GB/s DRAM. Actual mixed LoFi/HiFi2/HiFi4; HiFi4 peak is one quarter of this maximum.110 user cores are exposed. P300c spec is two ASICs; divided card DRAM bandwidth by2.
peak_sources: tt_perf_report/perf_report.py ArchitectureSpec blackhole per-core phase rates
assumptions: Whole-layer firmware spans, including normalization, movement and gaps, are the denominator for both ratios.

Useful FLOPs count projections, active MoE, causal QK/PV or delta recurrence, and convolution. Small vector/transcendental operations are excluded from numerator; their full time remains in denominator.

DRAM is a compulsory-traffic lower-bound estimate: each active weight once, KV once,10 materialized FP32 state volumes for token GDN. Fused state uses addcmul into persistent storage, eliminating the outer-product intermediate and copy. Additional temporary traffic, tile padding, multicast reloads and caching are not modeled. This is not measured DRAM utilization.

Optimized per-role precision/fidelity is recorded in optimization; verify against matching runtime profile rows. FP32 GDN state; projection/cache precision is the supplied per-role policy. Unselected expert work (dense fused prefill or sparse tile-union), padding and algorithmic chunk intermediates are not useful FLOPs.
No percentage is clamped. These nominal-peak ratios are not per-op utilization averages.
